import ctypes
import os

# Load the dynamic libraries
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_sf_beta_inc function prototype
# double gsl_sf_beta_inc(const double a, const double b, const double x);
gsl.gsl_sf_beta_inc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_sf_beta_inc.restype = ctypes.c_double

def compute_incomplete_beta(a, b, x):
    """Compute the incomplete beta function using GSL."""
    return gsl.gsl_sf_beta_inc(a, b, x)
